decisions.statement: A reading moves only when the machine that took the reading sends the reading.
A reading is carried under the name of the readout the reading was taken for.
The moment carried is the moment the reading was taken rather than the moment the reading arrived.
A reading arriving is written beside the readout's own page.
A reading arriving is written outside the commit rather than into one.
A reading is written under the keys the reading module answers with.
The page a reading is written beside is placed by page type and slug rather than named here.
A readout no page is slugged for has its reading refused rather than written.
A reading written answers nothing, and a reading refused answers why.
A machine that starts again has every reading its readouts' pages carry.
A body that is not a whole reading is refused rather than held.
A reading below zero is carried rather than refused.
How fast a reading falls with the clock is carried beside that reading.
A body naming no rate is carried as a reading falling at nothing an hour.
A reading between two whole numbers is carried rather than refused.
A reading that is no finite number is refused rather than carried.
A moment that cannot be read is no reading.
A carrier presents the relay secret the machine the carrier carries to names.
An answer that is not OK is refused rather than counted as carried.
Running this file has the reading beside the readout that run names.
The line a carry says names the moment rather than the reading.
Where a reading is carried to is said where the carrier is run rather than held as a secret.
The readout carried under is read off the name of the page the readout was named by.
A readout with no reading beside the readout is said rather than carried as nothing.
A path naming no readout page is refused apart from a readout that has taken no reading.
A path naming no readout page is said at the level a journal keeps for an error.
A readout that has taken no reading is said at no level of its own.
A reading is written with the values a write keeps rather than with a body a write puts.
A write putting a body would commit the readout page every reading.
The helper a test carries a reading over HTTP with sits here rather than in each test.
A test proving a carry is refused reads the answer rather than being thrown at.
A test carrying one readout's reading again and again names that readout once.
Nothing here takes a reading.
Nothing here decides when a reading is due.
Nothing here decides a reading held is too old to show.

definition: the reading carried from the machine that took it to the machine that shows it
